excluded: SSH private keys and credential stores
Tailscale node state and invite/login links
private payment QR images/full raw chat logs
source_policy: Copied source bytes preserved exactly; sensitive runtime JSON fields sanitized when present; source hashes retained.
scan: Known credentials and strong private-key/GitHub/Tailscale token patterns checked; no credential-context hits. Reviewed public documentation URLs and hardware identifiers preserved.
not_a_guarantee: Pattern scan is an engineering check, not a formal proof of absence of all possible private data.
